rules: Each filter applies to the input record based on event kind, with clamp rules enforcing 0–1000 reads per minute and interpolation normalizing missing values using median of available records; all parameters are derived from interface inventory and rate ceilings.
invariants: Output must satisfy exact unit labeling, total shipment count matches sum of individual records, and all derived values pass validation via the storage facade trait; mismatches trigger hard errors in the reconciliation check located in the rules engine.
